C: › [ C ] something that is said or done in order to be funny
› intended as a joke and not said seriously

NONE: › to say something intended to be funny

example: His proposal was no jest - he was completely sincere.
他的建議不是開玩笑，他絕對是認真的。
I only said it in jest - you're obviously not fat.
我那麼說是開玩笑——顯然你並不胖。
Would I jest about something so important?
我會拿這麼重要的事開玩笑嗎？

NONE: › a man in the past whose job was to tell jokes and make people laugh
› a Roman Catholic priest who is a member of the Society of Jesus, a religious group begun in 1540
› the man believed by his religious followers to be the son of God. Christianity is based on his life and teachings.
› an expression of surprise, shock, or anger. Some people might consider this use offensive.
（表示驚訝、震驚或惱怒）天哪（該表達法有時被認為具有冒犯性）

example: Jesus, just look what a mess they've made!
天哪，看看他們搞得一團糟！
